title: Path2 findings table
description: Scored cells for the research-page findings tab. Each item in cells is one scored cell and carries both sides (long and short). Rows are added only from a Marcus-sealed table, not from briefs. Leave a metric null when the sealed table does not contain it. verdict is PASS or FAIL only when the sealed table says so. green_year_note is a note and must not be copied into verdict or treated as a pass.

note.description: Operator note. The shipped file states that rows come only from a Marcus-sealed table, not from briefs.

sealed.description: True when Marcus has sealed the rows in cells. A false file with an empty cells list is the empty state.

cells.description: One record per scored cell. Append another object here for a later lean. Do not redesign the columns.

id.description: Stable id for this cell. Not a score.

green_year_note.description: Optional note about a green year. Not a verdict. Must not flip PASS or FAIL.

verdict.description: Cell verdict from the sealed table. Null when the table does not say PASS or FAIL. Do not derive this from green_year_note or from either side's net.

sides.description: Both sides stay on the cell. A side with no figures is an object of nulls, not an omitted side.

thresholds.description: Frozen thresholds for this cell. Use label for the operator line, or fill the pieces the sealed table actually has. Null pieces are omitted from the line.
